name: Notifier
description: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的专业能力扩展插件，提供免配置一键安装与高效辅助支持。
descriptionEn: Unified notification push plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): one minimal notify() API, 8 channel adapters (telegram/dingtalk/feishu/wxpusher/pushplus/serverchan/bark/webhook), dual trigger (auto session events + agent tool).
author: MingLin
